top_signals.title: Ambani Heirs Face Tough Questions in Roadshow for Record Jio IPO
top_signals.summary: Jio Platforms Ltd.’s push for a record initial public offering has drawn investor skepticism over its lofty valuation aspirations, providing an early test for Ambani heir Akash who’s leading a major Reliance Industries Ltd. transaction on his own for the first time.

top_signals.title: Extreme rain is testing Japan’s flood defences
top_signals.summary: More intense rain is overwhelming flood defenses and reaching places outside predicted risk zones, leaving residents to confront unexpected dangers.
